notes: Renders a wrapper `<div>` around the trigger and the bubble. Base UI instead portals the bubble to the document body through a Positioner, which is what makes collision detection and clipping work; nothing in the contract can express a portal, a layer or an anchor, so this binding keeps the bubble in place and the tooltip will be clipped by any ancestor with `overflow: hidden`.
What OPENS the tooltip is not generated. The contract says hover-with-delay and focus in prose; `activates` covers only activation, so the emitted component exposes `open` and never sets it.
Escape-to-dismiss is not generated either. There is no way to declare a key that is not activation.
